indexing: At cycle n, use rows 0 through 479 and add n*99.2 mm to every world X field; add n*4 seconds to timestamps. Row 480 is a closing endpoint for interpolation/validation, not an extra held sample.
interpolation: Monotone cubic with the same endpoint tangent on both sides of the seam. C1 continuity; acceleration continuity not guaranteed at every key.
start_stop_policy: The original full clip retains standing transitions. This loop must be entered/exited through a phase-matched transition, not an instantaneous command from stand.
